subject: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount — Velocity AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@velocity.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@velocity.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Velocity AI — request for hosted API discount approval

Priyom,

Quick one — Velocity AI is pushing for a deeper upfront discount to secure a 12-month committed hosted API agreement. They want 25% off list for tokens and embeddings for the first 12 months; expected usage profile is ~140M tokens/mo with an initial ramp in Q1. This is outside our standard delegated authority (>20%), so I'm escalating for exec sign-off.

Summary:
- Customer: Velocity AI (startup, Series B)
- Ask: 25% discount on Hosted API usage for 12 months (monthly billing, net 30)
- Commit: 12 months, expected average 140M tokens/mo; 3-month ramp from P0
- Strategic notes: they integrate deeply with platform and want a Dedicated evaluation after 6 months — potential to convert to Reserved capacity.

Attachments: VelocityAI_QBR_pricing.xlsx (pricing worksheet), SOW_VelocityAI_draft.pdf (draft SOW)

Requested: executive sign-off or guidance on concessions and billing (prepay vs net invoice) by end of day tomorrow — legal and finance need clarity to prepare final SOW.

Ben
Account Exec — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@velocity.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@velocity.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Velocity AI — request for hosted API discount approval

Team — looping you in for rapid review. Ben has asked for a 25% concession (outside delegated approval). Key asks below; please reply with Constraints / Approval / Questions.

Key points to evaluate:
- Is 25% acceptable given projected volume (~140M tokens/mo)?
- Do we require prepayment/advance invoice for the first quarter to mitigate revenue risk?
- Should we attach a 60-day business review and performance clause tied to conversion to Dedicated?
- Any legal terms we need (usage caps, SLA)?

Ben, I gave the customer a tentative timeline to have final terms by 5/4. Mina/Laura/Rishi — if you can give a decision or list of required conditions by tomorrow morning, I’ll close the loop with Velocity and hand to legal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Deal Desk — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Velocity AI — request for hosted API discount approval

Priyom / team,

Reviewed the attached pricing worksheet. Quick callouts:
- Economics: At 140M tokens/mo, 25% discount reduces ARR contribution materially, but the upsell path to Dedicated (high-margin) makes this defensible as a land-in strategy.
- Recommendation: Approve up to 25% conditional on the following:
  • 12-month minimum term (yes)
  • Billing: Quarterly invoicing with 30 days net, but require a 1-quarter advance deposit (applied to invoices) as a revenue-protection mechanism.
  • Metrics review at 60 days to validate ramp and potential Dedicated migration.
  • Cap list-price-protection to prevent retroactive refund if usage dips below baseline after month 3.

If Finance/Legal are comfortable with the advance deposit and review clause, I’m happy to sign off from RevOps. HubSpot deal page and usage forecast: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-2027-0621-VEL

Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Velocity AI — request for hosted API discount approval

Folks,

Finance approves the concession up to 25% on the conditions Mina outlined. Two additional constraints for signoff:
1) We require the 1-quarter advance deposit (applied to invoice) before activating billing.
2) Net-30 payment terms to be retained; if delinquency observed in first 90 days, we reserve the right to revert pricing to list and pause API keys after 15 days notice.

Rishi — please add an SLA paragraph and a conversion path clause into the SOW (60-day review + opt-in Dedicated pilot terms). Ben / Priyom, you can communicate this to Velocity with the caveat that legal will issue a final SOW and the advance deposit must be received prior to first invoicing.

Approve: 25% max discount for 12-month committed Hosted API with conditions (advance deposit, 60-day review, revert provision).

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Revenue
Redwood Inference
